note: Bits farmed from other morning shows, rewritten as JB & Sandy Austin versions. Items older than 7 days drop to the archive. Newest first.

items.title: Is sending an Uber to pick up your date acceptable?
items.how: The crew debates whether sending a rideshare to pick up a date is thoughtful or a red flag.
items.ours: JB, Sandy and Tricia rule on whether an Uber pickup counts as a real date move or a cop-out. Phones: Austin, would you get in the Uber, or is that a dealbreaker?

items.title: Running into the paletero man and reconnecting with an old friend
items.how: Ana has her first run-in with the paletero man since she was a kid, and Audrey tells the story of reconnecting with an old friend.
items.ours: We trade the childhood thing that still makes us feel ten years old when we see it, and the old friend we reconnected with out of nowhere. Phones: Austin, who's the friend you found again after years?

items.title: Weird jobs: could you walk a robot dog?
items.how: The room reacts to a list of strange new jobs, starting with getting paid to walk a robot dog.
items.ours: Sandy reads a few real oddball job listings and JB and Tricia say which one they'd actually take. Phones: Austin, what's the weirdest job you've ever been paid to do?

items.title: Love Letters: she looks just like her boyfriend's ex
items.how: The Love Expert answers a listener who found out she looks a lot like her boyfriend's ex.
items.ours: Tricia reads the letter and we each say whether that's a compliment, a coincidence, or a reason to worry. Phones: Austin, have you ever found out you were someone's type a little too exactly?

items.title: Whatcha doin' at the haunted house?
items.how: They send two producers to a scary haunted house to ask the people waiting in line one simple question and play back the answers.
items.ours: Austin haunted-house season edition: we ask who in the studio is the first one to bail out of a haunted house. Phones: Austin, have you ever had to be walked out of a haunted house?

items.title: Shock Collar Question: the front-yard graveyard arms race
items.how: They riff on neighbors spending thousands to turn front lawns into graveyards and garages into haunted torture chambers, then ask the question of the day.
items.ours: JB, Sandy and Tricia guess how much their own neighbors spent on Halloween yard decor this year. Phones: Austin, who's got the over-the-top Halloween house on your street?

items.show: Elvis Duran and the Morning Show
items.title: Dad plans a surprise for his daughter's elopement
items.how: A listener whose daughter is eloping to save the family money calls in about his plan to surprise her so he can still walk her down the aisle.
items.ours: Feel-good story setup, then we each share the best family surprise we've ever pulled off or been on the receiving end of. Phones: Austin, what's the surprise that made you cry?

items.title: Accidentally posted it
items.how: The crew trades stories about posting something online by accident that they wish they could take back.
items.ours: We confess our worst accidental post, text or reply-all. Phones: Austin, what did you accidentally post, and who saw it?

items.title: Shannon loves when plans get canceled
items.how: Shannon admits the best feeling in the world is when plans fall through, and the room argues about it.
items.ours: Sandy, JB and Tricia each say whether a canceled plan is a disappointment or a gift. Phones: Austin, are you secretly hoping your Friday plans get canceled?

items.title: Not my baby anymore
items.how: Parents in the room share the moments that made them realize their kids weren't little anymore.
items.ours: Tricia and Sandy share the moment it hit them that a kid grew up. Phones: Austin, what was the moment you realized your baby wasn't a baby anymore?

items.title: Shut up, Dad: sideline parents
items.how: The show talks about that parent in the stands yelling 'get him out of the game' at kids' sports.
items.ours: JB and Sandy describe the loudest sideline parent they've ever seen at a youth game. Phones: Austin, are you the yelling parent, or do you sit as far from them as you can?

items.title: Instacart's most popular Halloween candy list
items.how: The crew runs through Instacart's list of the most popular Halloween candy and argues over the rankings.
items.ours: JB, Sandy and Tricia each rank their top three trick-or-treat candies two days before Halloween. Phones: Austin, what's the best candy in the bowl, and what's the one you leave at the bottom?

items.title: Things that are embarrassing for no reason
items.how: Ana brings a list of everyday things that feel embarrassing even though they shouldn't, and the room adds their own.
items.ours: Each of us confesses the totally normal thing that still makes us cringe, like waving back at someone who wasn't waving at you. Phones: Austin, what's embarrassing for you for absolutely no reason?

items.title: New homeowner needs help hosting guests
items.how: Ana just bought a house and asks the show for help figuring out how to host guests for the first time.
items.ours: Tricia and Sandy give JB a crash course in being a good host before the holidays hit. Phones: Austin, what's the one thing a great host always does?

items.title: Gen Z gets parents' help with their resumes
items.how: The show reacts to a report that Gen Z job hunters are getting their parents to help write their resumes.
items.ours: We compare how we got our first jobs with how kids get them now. Phones: Austin, did your parents help you land your first job, and how?

items.title: What's On Our Minds: Brooke wants to scare her family
items.how: They go around the room: Brooke is determined to scare her family this Halloween, Jose overspent at a football game, and Jeffrey has a gripe with how his cleaners clean.
items.ours: Around the room Austin-style: JB, Sandy and Tricia each bring one thing that's bugging them this week. Phones: Austin, what's on your mind this morning?

items.title: Battle of the Tinder Dates: Halloween edition
items.how: Two listeners go head to head over who has the worst Tinder dating life, in a Halloween edition of the segment.
items.ours: Two Austin callers battle over the scariest first date they've been on, and the room picks a winner. Phones: Austin, what's your worst Halloween-season date?

items.show: Elvis Duran and the Morning Show
items.title: Is a haunted house the ultimate first-date test?
items.how: Gandhi explains why a haunted house might expose someone's true colors on a first date, and the room debates it.
items.ours: We debate whether a haunted house tells you everything you need to know about a date. Phones: Austin, what did a scary date reveal about someone?

items.title: Bathroom etiquette
items.how: The guys trade their unfiltered opinions on public bathroom etiquette and the rules people break.
items.ours: JB and Sandy lay out their public restroom rules and Tricia rules on who's right. Phones: Austin, what's the bathroom etiquette rule people break that drives you crazy?

items.title: Shannon overshared with the boss
items.how: Shannon tells the story of oversharing with her boss and having to apologize for it.
items.ours: Each of us admits the time we told a boss way too much. Phones: Austin, what's the worst thing you ever overshared at work?

items.title: Anna's last-minute Halloween costumes
items.how: Anna and callers pitch easy last-minute Halloween costume ideas, from simple to DIY.
items.ours: Last-minute costume rescue: callers pitch costumes you can make from stuff already in your house, and we pick the best. Phones: Austin, what's your best costume made in under ten minutes?

items.title: PT Justin learns how to say no
items.how: PT Justin, the guy who can't turn anybody down, gets coached on the air on how to finally say "no."
items.ours: Put JB on the spot with a run of rapid-fire favors and see if he can say no to even one. Phones: Austin, what did you say yes to that you totally should have said no to?

items.title: Love Letters: boyfriend hates how much time she spends with family
items.how: Kellie, the show's love expert, answers a listener whose boyfriend doesn't like how much time she spends with her family.
items.ours: Tricia reads the letter and the room weighs in on where the line is. Phones: Austin, how much family time is too much in a relationship?

items.title: Audrey's list of misunderstood villains
items.how: Audrey brings a list of movie and TV villains she thinks got a bad rap, and the room argues over each one.
items.ours: JB, Sandy and Tricia each defend one famous villain just in time for Halloween. Phones: Austin, which movie bad guy was actually right?

items.title: Worst date: she never got fed
items.how: Kaylin tells the story of a date where she somehow never got anything to eat.
items.ours: Share the worst first-date food fails in the room. Phones: Austin, what's the worst thing that happened with the food on a first date?

items.title: Masked Speaker: the camping trip secret
items.how: A listener breaks a five-year pact with his buddies to tell, anonymously, what really happened on a camping trip.
items.ours: Open the phones for anonymous "we swore we'd never tell" stories, voices disguised. Phones: Austin, what's the story your friends made you promise never to tell?

items.title: Plenty of Twenty: Sinister Sing Along
items.how: They play their Plenty of Twenty game in a spooky Halloween sing-along edition.
items.ours: Play the intro of a Halloween-ish song and make callers finish the lyric to win. Phones: Austin, call in and sing the next line to win.

items.show: Elvis Duran and the Morning Show
items.title: Around the room: remembering our pets
items.how: Elvis goes around the room as the crew remembers the pets they've lost, along with a birthday for Sam's dog.
items.ours: JB, Sandy and Tricia each tell a story about a pet they still miss. Phones: Austin, tell us about the pet you'll never forget.

items.show: Elvis Duran and the Morning Show
items.title: Things we refuse to learn
items.how: The crew lists the everyday skills they flat-out refuse to ever learn.
items.ours: Everybody admits the skill they'll never bother with, like parallel parking or folding a fitted sheet. Phones: Austin, what's the one thing you refuse to learn how to do?

items.title: Am I the A-hole: going out two weeks after giving birth
items.how: They take an "Am I the a-hole" story from a new mom who went out two weeks after giving birth and let listeners judge.
items.ours: Read the dilemma and let the phones vote it out. Phones: Austin, how soon after a baby is too soon to go out with friends?

items.title: Anna offended Mojo: is chivalry still a thing?
items.how: Anna and Mojo get into it about chivalry and what being a good partner or friend means now.
items.ours: Settle it on the air: doors, check, coat, who walks curbside. Phones: Austin, what's one old-school manners rule you still expect?

items.title: Kellie reviews Lay's holiday potato chips
items.how: Kellie taste-tests Lay's new holiday potato chip flavors on the air and gives her verdict.
items.ours: Bring a bag of the holiday flavors in and do a blind taste test with JB, Sandy and Tricia. Phones: Austin, what's the worst holiday-flavored snack you've ever bought?

items.title: Home decor trends people regret
items.how: They run through a list of home decor trends people don't like and regret doing.
items.ours: JB, Sandy and Tricia each name the decor trend they'd rip out tomorrow. Phones: Austin, what home trend did you jump on and now regret?

items.title: PT Justin's list of ways to be lazy
items.how: Justin finds a list of ways to be lazy and the room ranks which ones they already do.
items.ours: Read the list and have the guys confess which ones they're guilty of. Phones: Austin, what's your laziest life hack you're secretly proud of?

items.title: Small world: moving next to a childhood friend
items.how: Ana's husband finds out they're moving near a childhood friend, and they swap small-world stories.
items.ours: Each of us tells our best small-world moment. Phones: Austin, where did you run into someone from your past in the most random place?

items.title: Halloween Missed Connections
items.how: They read the strangest Craigslist Missed Connections posts, Halloween edition.
items.ours: Read a few real Austin-style Missed Connections and let JB and Sandy guess what happened next. Phones: Austin, ever try to find someone you locked eyes with and never saw again?

items.title: Most-searched duo costumes
items.how: Shock Collar Question: the team guesses the most-searched couples and duo Halloween costumes on Google.
items.ours: Make JB and Sandy guess the top duo costumes, loser picks their costume. Phones: Austin, what's the best (or worst) couples costume you ever did?

items.title: Second Date Update: ghosted at Halloween
items.how: A listener met a woman during spooky season and got ghosted, so they call her to find out why.
items.ours: Halloween version of the ghosting talk. Phones: Austin, what's the weirdest reason you've been ghosted, or ghosted someone?

items.show: Elvis Duran and the Morning Show
items.title: Should kids be banned from flights and restaurants?
items.how: They debate adults-only flights and restaurants, share worst kid travel stories, and ask if adults are the bigger problem.
items.ours: Who's worse on a Southwest flight out of AUS, the kids or the grown-ups? Phones: Austin, worst seatmate you've ever had, kid or adult?

items.show: Elvis Duran and the Morning Show
items.title: Halloween Mashup game
items.how: Callers try to guess which Halloween movies a set of sound clips came from.
items.ours: Play spooky-movie sound clips and have callers race JB and Sandy to name the movie. Phones: Austin, what scary movie still messes you up?

items.title: Is your PIN your ex's birthday?
items.how: Listeners admit they still use an ex's birthday or details as their PIN and passwords, and why.
items.ours: Sandy and JB confess what their passwords are built around (not the actual passwords). Phones: Austin, is your PIN still tied to an ex?

items.title: Would you pay $10K to deep clean your house?
items.how: They debate whether a $10,000 top-to-bottom deep cleaning of your home is ever worth it.
items.ours: What's your number for a deep clean, and what room would you make them start with? Phones: Austin, what's the grossest spot in your house you'd pay anything to have cleaned?

items.title: Running into your frenemy in public
items.how: Ana tells the story of catching her frenemy out in public and how the run-in went.
items.ours: JB, Sandy and Tricia each confess their frenemy (no names). Phones: Austin, where did you get stuck making small talk with somebody you can't stand, H-E-B or a kid's game?

items.title: Worst date: Justin's red-flag list
items.how: Justin runs down every red flag from a recent date, then Jsi brings an Am I the Jerk moment.
items.ours: Name the one red flag that ends a date for you on the spot. Phones: Austin, what's the red flag you ignored and regretted?

items.title: Whatcha doin' at Spirit Halloween?
items.how: They sent two staffers into the costume pop-up madness to ask shoppers what they were doing there.
items.ours: Send Tricia (or an intern) to a Spirit Halloween in Austin with a mic. Phones: what's the costume you're still hunting for with five days to go?

items.title: Second Date Update: the one question he dodged
items.how: Daniel desperately avoided one question on his date with Lilly; it got asked anyway, went badly, and he wants help fixing it.
items.ours: What's the first-date question you dread getting asked? Phones: Austin, what question blew up a date for you?

items.title: Laser Stories
items.how: Weird news from around the world read with laser sound effects dropped in for no reason at all.
items.ours: JB and Sandy's weird-news block with a silly sound effect Tricia picks off the board. Phones: Austin, send us the weirdest local headline you saw this week.

items.title: Kev's mom dreamt Kev had another son
items.how: Kev's mom shares a dream that Kev had another son, and the show gets into moms who seem to sense the future.
items.ours: Has your mom ever called with a dream or a feeling that turned out right? Phones: Austin, who's the family member with the spooky sixth sense?

items.title: Mike bought the wrong Lions tickets
items.how: Mike tells the story of buying tickets to the wrong Lions game and the crew piles on.
items.ours: Biggest ticket mistake ever, wrong date, wrong city, wrong section. Phones: Austin, who bought the wrong Longhorns or concert tickets?

items.title: Do men really love redheads?
items.how: The show tackles the claim that men are especially drawn to redheads and argues over whether it holds up.
items.ours: JB, Sandy and Tricia rank hair color myths. Phones: Austin, what's the one physical thing that always gets your attention?

items.show: Elvis Duran and the Morning Show
items.title: Skeery ate a painting
items.how: On the road at Baha Mar, Skeery discovers the artwork is edible, and Gandhi has a surprise reunion 15 years in the making.
items.ours: Weirdest thing you ever ate without realizing what it was. Phones: Austin, what's the strangest thing you've eaten on vacation?

items.title: Christmas card of just you (or just you and the dog)
items.how: They debate whether it is weird to send out a Christmas card that is only you, or only you and your pet.
items.ours: JB and Sandy rule on it, Tricia brings the receipts from cards we got. Phones: what is the weirdest Christmas card you ever got in Austin?

items.title: Halloween decorating is the new side hustle
items.how: Story that people are now getting paid to decorate other folks' houses for Halloween, plus a phone-battery overcharging warning.
items.ours: Would you pay someone to do your yard, and what would you charge? Phones: Austin, who has the over-the-top Halloween house on your street?

items.title: Worst date: the hard kisser
items.how: A listener calls in to describe a date who was way too hard of a kisser.
items.ours: Keep it PG: what is the one move on a first date that ended it for you instantly? Phones open, Tricia scores the calls.

items.title: Awkward Thursday Phone Call: HOA vs. the Candy King
items.how: A caller's HOA is threatening to fine him hundreds of dollars if he goes through with his favorite Halloween tradition, so the show calls on his behalf.
items.ours: Austin HOA horror stories for Halloween week. Phones: what did your HOA try to fine you for, and did you fight it?

items.title: Kev won't let Anna drive his truck
items.how: Anna asks to drive Kevin's F-150, he hesitates, and it turns into a debate about who is the worst driver on the show.
items.ours: Who is the worst driver among JB, Sandy and Tricia? We each make the case. Phones: who in your family is never allowed to drive your truck?

items.title: Airbnb is banning unreasonable checkout chores
items.how: News that Airbnb is cracking down on hosts who pile chores on guests at checkout, opened up to texts and calls.
items.ours: Lake Travis and Fredericksburg rental stories. Phones: what is the most ridiculous checkout chore a rental ever made you do?

items.title: 5 @ 6:55: going for 15 in a row
items.how: Daily five-question trivia game; a listener on a 14-win streak goes head to head against co-host Shannon.
items.ours: A five-question KVET country trivia game where a caller tries to beat Tricia, with a running win streak. Phones: who thinks they can take her?

items.show: Elvis Duran and the Morning Show
items.title: Her waiter boyfriend got a $1,000 tip from a smitten customer
items.how: The guys debate how a woman reacted after finding out a customer who had a crush on her waiter boyfriend tipped him $1,000.
items.ours: Do you let him keep it, or is that crush money? Phones: what is the biggest tip you ever got (or gave), and what was the story?

items.show: Elvis Duran and the Morning Show
items.title: What would your three wishes be?
items.how: Sherri Shepherd, Broadway's first female genie in Aladdin, joins and the show gets into everyone's three wishes.
items.ours: JB, Sandy and Tricia each get three wishes, no wishing for more wishes. Phones: Austin, what is your first wish and why?

items.title: Amputate it or stitch it to your side?
items.how: Hypothetical question to the room: lose your arm, or have it stitched to your side for two months?
items.ours: JB and Sandy each pick and defend it, Tricia breaks the tie. Phones: which one, and what would you miss doing most?

items.title: KiddNation Confession: what happened to Mom's car
items.how: A listener finally confesses what really happened to his mom's car years ago.
items.ours: Austin Confession Booth: what did you do to a parent's car that they still don't know about? Phones open, statute of limitations applies.

items.title: Baby talk to your dog is good for it
items.how: Study says talking to your dog in a baby voice is actually beneficial; the room admits their dog voices.
items.ours: Sandy and JB do their pet voices on air. Phones: call in and do the voice you use with your dog (or cat).

items.title: A co-host's grandpa calls with a question
items.how: A cast member's grandfather calls in and puts another host on the spot with an interesting question.
items.ours: Get Tricia's or JB's relative on the phone to ask Sandy one question, unscreened. Phones: what question does your grandparent always ask?

items.title: Dumbest way you got hurt
items.how: A co-host is on a scooter after a self-inflicted injury and has to explain how it happened.
items.ours: Each of us shares our dumbest self-inflicted injury. Phones: how did you hurt yourself doing something stupid?

items.title: What's On Your Mind: the Early Birds club
items.how: Around-the-room segment: Brooke tried an 'Early Birds' club and loved it, Jeff ended up bartending on his birthday.
items.ours: We are early birds by trade. Phones: what's the earliest thing you do on purpose, and is anything in Austin worth getting up for?

items.title: Shock Collar Question
items.how: Quiz game where every question is about Doja Cat, Kim Kardashian or Judge Judy, with a penalty for wrong answers.
items.ours: Pop culture lightning round with a buzzer penalty (no actual shock): JB vs. Sandy, all questions about three random celebs Tricia picks.

items.show: Elvis Duran and the Morning Show
items.title: Paying for a seat at a stranger's wedding
items.how: Talk about a new platform that lets you pay to attend a stranger's wedding, plus who you would spend your last hour with.
items.ours: Would you pay to crash a Hill Country wedding, and how much? Phones: best wedding you went to where you barely knew the couple.

items.title: He who writes the check gets to dress the neck
items.how: Wedding etiquette fight: does whoever pays get to pick what the wedding party wears?
items.ours: Phones: if you pay for it, do you get a say? Weddings, family trips, kids' cars. JB and Sandy take opposite sides.

items.title: My smartwatch called 911
items.how: A host's smartwatch called 911 by accident and the show walks through the fallout.
items.ours: Phones: what did your tech do without asking? Watch called 911, car read a text out loud, Alexa ordered something.

items.title: What time should coffee shops open?
items.how: The show argues the right opening time for a coffee shop.
items.ours: We are on at 6. Name the Austin coffee spots that are not open yet when we are. Phones: what time should they open?

items.title: Today Years Old
items.how: Hosts reveal facts they only just learned and how old they were when they found out.
items.ours: JB and Sandy each confess one fact they learned embarrassingly late. Phones: how old were you?

items.title: Can you tickle yourself?
items.how: Light studio test and caller reactions about tickling yourself.
items.ours: Quick live test on air with JB. Short and silly, good for a tease.

items.title: Second Date Update: the Microwaved Salad Guy
items.how: Caller got ghosted after a first date. The show calls the date to find out why, and the reason is the punchline.
items.ours: Our version: Ghosted, Austin edition. Listener submits a date that went quiet, we call and find out. Phones: weirdest date habit you have seen.

items.title: Phone tap: the misspelled proposal fortune cookie
items.how: Prank call blaming a guy for the typo that turned his fiancee's name into Dennis.
items.ours: Not a prank (we skip those), but a phones topic: worst typo on something important, like a cake, a tattoo or a wedding invite.

items.title: Half your office is now her closet
items.how: Prank where a closet installer says the wife put a deposit down to turn half his office into her closet.
items.ours: Phones: who won the space war in your house? Garage, office or closet. Sandy and JB each pick a side.

pick.title: Lick your shoe or chew the mystery desk gum?
pick.how: On the Friday show Jonesy and Amanda debate which is worse: licking the bottom of your shoe or chewing a piece of mystery gum stuck under a desk.
pick.ours: Gross-out would-you-rather: JB, Sandy and Tricia each pick their poison and defend it, then we throw out a couple more Austin versions. Phones: Austin, which one are you doing, and what's your own worse-is-worse question?
